rotate-partitions.name: rotate-partitions
rotate-partitions.description: Keeps the event and reporting tables partitioned ahead of the calendar, and merges old periods so the tables stay within the server's open-file limit. Deletes nothing unless told to keep less history (raw_retention_months, and cube_retention_months per Property).

drain-tracker-ingest.name: drain-tracker-ingest
drain-tracker-ingest.description: Ingests the beacons waiting in the tracker-ingest queue: every beacon when queueing is on, and any whose write failed and is waiting to be retried. First forwards any beacons the AWS SQS queue refused and the file queue kept. A minute with nothing waiting costs a few file checks.

replay-tracker-ingest.name: replay-tracker-ingest
replay-tracker-ingest.description: Gives each beacon in the tracker-ingest dead-letter queue one more try, once: one that failed during an outage longer than the retries gets ingested after all. One already replayed is kept for cmd=tracker-ingest-replay: in the file queue until it is replayed, in AWS SQS for the queue's fourteen-day retention, after which SQS deletes it. One older than raw_retention_months is deleted instead.

prune-tracker-ingest-archive.name: prune-tracker-ingest-archive
prune-tracker-ingest-archive.description: Deletes the tracking intake's archived batch files older than raw_retention_months, the window event data is kept for. Deletes nothing when that is not set.

prune-job-queue.name: prune-job-queue
prune-job-queue.description: Deletes finished one-off jobs from the job queue: done ones after 7 days, failed ones after 30.

rebuild-cube.name: rebuild-cube
rebuild-cube.description: Builds each Property's reporting cube from new events, so reports are at most a few minutes behind. Skips the days that have not changed.

apply-custom-dimensions.name: apply-custom-dimensions
apply-custom-dimensions.description: Adds the columns for newly registered custom dimensions to the reporting cubes. Adding one rebuilds the table, which is too slow for the request that registered it. With nothing pending it is one quick read.

core-update.name: core-update
core-update.description: Automatic updates, every hour: four times a day lists OWA's releases for the notifications bell, and downloads and verifies the release to update to; then installs it, in the update window if one is set. The files are copied when the run's other jobs have finished, and the next run finishes the install.

base.trackingPageViews.description: When the tracker sends a page view, and what identifies the page.

base.trackingClicks.description: Clicks on links and other elements, and which links count as downloads.

base.trackingForms.description: A visitor starting and submitting a form.

base.trackingScroll.description: How far down each page visitors get.

base.trackingSearch.description: Searches made with your site’s own search box, read from the results page’s URL.

base.trackingErrors.description: Uncaught errors in your pages’ scripts.

base.trackingVisit.description: How long the tracker’s cookies hold a visit and a visitor together, and the domain they are set on.

base.trackingPrivacy.description: Browsers that ask not to be tracked, with Do Not Track or Global Privacy Control.

base.retention.description: Each night's maintenance run (rotate-partitions) removes data outside these windows. Every Property can set its own reporting window on its Data Retention page.
